fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK) rose 6.82% from $1,887.04 following Rosenblatt Securities' new $2,400 price target initiation, driven by increased AI and data center demand, with Q4 revenue of $8.97B (51% sequential increase) and operating margin of 84.6%.
fields.summary_ko.1: SanDisk's data center segment revenue grew 437% in fiscal year 2026, with NAND flash memory data center demand expected to reach approximately 1.2 zettabytes by 2030.
